headline: Terna, revenues of €3.11 billion and net profit of €857.2 million in the first nine months of 2026
summary: Terna reported revenues of €3.11 billion and net profit of €857.2 million for the first nine months of 2026. CEO Monti said investment in the national transmission grid will continue.
why: Terna operates Italy's high-voltage electricity transmission grid, a regulated monopoly whose investment plans drive its earnings and capital spending.
